title: Listing Packages
description: Manage service packages that providers offer for their listings.

help.title: About Listing packages
help.overview: A package is a priced tier of a listing, such as Basic, Standard, or Premium. When a buyer orders with a package, the package's price and delivery days replace the listing's base price and delivery days.

sections.title: Fields
items: Listing is required and fixed; only that listing's provider can create or delete its packages.
Name and description describe the tier. Display order sorts packages on the listing, lower first.
Price amount and currency are what the order charges. Delivery days become the order's due-date window.

sections.title: Ordering with a package
items: Add-ons chosen with the package must use the package's currency; their extra days are added on top.
A listing needs no packages; without one, its own price is used.
Deleting is a soft delete. A package cannot be restored while its listing is deleted.
